name: Basic Agent Evaluation
description: Sample evaluation set for testing core agent functionality. Customize these cases to match your agent's actual capabilities.

parts.text: Hello, what can you help me with?

rubric_content.text_property: The response is a conversational reply that introduces the agent's capabilities to the user. Plain text describing what the agent can help with passes. A bare reflexive acknowledgement ('Hi!') with no description of capabilities fails.

The response does NOT invoke any tool. A greeting or open-ended 'what can you help with' is small talk — the agent should reply conversationally instead of reaching for `bash`, `read`, `web_search`, or any other tool to inspect the environment. Any FunctionCall in the response fails this rubric (this pins the system-prompt gate that tells the agent not to run tools unprompted).

parts.text: What's the weather like in San Francisco?
